about: The project's settings, public halves only (this file is public in sign.app/web/ and inside the APK). Picture: md/infrastructure-setup.svg; order of the start: md/INFRASTRUCTURE.md "Start". doors: the door's read link (join/: answers, sealed per device) and its file-drop link (hello/); more doors = tried in order (one may be gone); empty = no automatic join, a group text works as before. signer: the anchors whose seal counts at the door: the admin device (q_ z_) and, after the emergency sheet, the paper (a list or lines; up on the own tile copies both); empty = the description in join/. The same z_ go once by hand into SIGNERS of gateway/gateway.env: the gateway never reads this file. admin: the user that gets only the summary · atlas: the user that reads every Sign/ and counts · groups: the user that holds the group folders (a group outlives any one person's account) · group: the Nextcloud group every new account joins (Admin, Atlas and Groups are not counted as accounts). web: where the web app lives; the native app opens its confirm.html there for the Admin password. gateway: the Sign gateway of the project's object storage (https://gateway.<domain>); set = the admin's hello back also gives each person her own sharing point there (<user>/Sign/) with a grant for the asking device; empty = Nextcloud only.
label: Sign
